## About Me
I am a data scientist and biochemist. Since April 2026 I have been acting professor (Vertretungsprofessur, W3) and director of the [Institute of Medical Statistics](https://www.ukaachen.de/kliniken-institute/institut-fuer-medizinische-statistik/institut/) at University Hospital RWTH Aachen. I also lead the [Preclinical Data Science](https://www.mhh.de/talbot)  group at the Institute for Laboratory Animal Science, Hannover Medical School (MHH).
 
My work lives where artificial intelligence, statistics, and translational research meet, for patients of every kind: a person, an animal in the clinic, or an animal in the laboratory. I have a particular knack for severity assessment, clinical decision support, and the honest, practical use of AI. The RELSA (Relative Severity Assessment) score is one of my leading tools. It began as a way to put a number on an animal's suffering and has since grown into the Patient Vital Score (PVS), now watching over children in paediatric care.

And I am every bit as devoted to the craft: biometry, experimental design, and teaching the next generation to wield statistics and machine learning, and to bring the 3R principle to life.
 
## Research Interests

- **Severity Assessment**: Multidimensional scoring algorithms (e.g., RELSA) for objective burden quantification
- **AI in Regulatory Science**: LLM-assisted evaluation and optimization of animal experiment applications
- **Clinical Translation**: From animal welfare scores to human ICU monitoring (Patient Vital Status)
- **Experimental Design**: Bayesian sample size planning and multi-center reproducibility validation
- **3Rs & Alternative Methods**: Data-driven reduction strategies and organoid model validation
